nom: NIVEA MEN Maximum Hydration Face Wash

avis.texte: 1. Nivea changed the recipe. The old blue gel formula was changed to a clear formula that foams up more like handsoap. No one is happy about this. Not sure why they changed something that wasn't broken. The new recipe seems OK, but I greatly prefer the old formula. 2. Do not order this from Amazon. When they pack it, they will simply toss the bottles into a box with all your other ordered items. This means that it will get tossed around and potentially smashed during shipping. The last 2 times I ordered this, Amazon packed it in a box with heavy items causing these bottles to expload during shipment. Order it somewhere else where they can pack it properly.

avis.titre: Effective Face Wash with Refreshing Feel
avis.texte: The NIVEA MEN Maximum Hydration Moisturizing Face Wash with Aloe Vera works really well for daily use. It cleans thoroughly without leaving my skin feeling dry, and the aloe vera adds a nice refreshing touch. The texture is smooth and easy to apply, and a small amount goes a long way. I’ve noticed my skin feels softer and hydrated after using it regularly. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that the scent is a bit strong for my preference. Overall, great quality face wash at a good price and perfect for keeping skin clean and moisturized.

avis.titre: Great Face Wash That Doesn't Dry Out My Skin
avis.texte: I've been really happy with this face wash. It cleans my face well and leaves my skin feeling fresh without that tight, dry feeling that many other face washes cause. The aloe vera seems to help keep my skin hydrated after every wash.

I’m prone to problematic skin, so it was hard to find a great affordable face wash. I’ve tried many other brands, and my face still is still left irritated. This one is by far the best. This is the most soothing and moisturizing for my skin. It also works great after I shave my face. It lasts a while for the amount you get, so long as you don’t use more than you have to, which isn’t much. I also like that they took the coloring out of the ingredients. The only disappointment is I can’t find this in stores anymore because it’s either always out of stock or the place doesn’t sell it.

It cleans my skin thoroughly without leaving it feeling dry or tight, which is something I’ve had issues with using other products. The texture is smooth and easy to work into a lather, and a small amount goes a long way. It rinses off clean, leaving my face feeling refreshed and hydrated rather than stripped. After using it, my skin feels balanced and looks noticeably healthier. What stands out most is how well it maintains moisture while still giving that deep-clean feeling. It’s strong enough to remove dirt and oil but still gentle enough for everyday use without irritation. The scent is clean and not overpowering, which is a plus. Overall, it’s a dependable face wash that delivers consistent results and keeps my skin feeling fresh and hydrated throughout the day.

avis.titre: Nivea says same formula, but the ingredient concentrations have changed.
avis.texte: Water, glycerin, denatured alcohol are the first three ingredients of the new clear formula. Then cocamidopropyl betaine (CAPB), which is the main surfactant in the formula, was second and now is fourth. Surfactants in soap increase the surface area and lathering ability of soaps. Higher surface area increases the chances of interacting with oils and other foreign material from the surface of one's skin so it can then rinse off. If you look at the last screenshot of the product you will see the older formula that lists glycerin as the 5th ingredient. As you know ingredients are listed by concentration, so they have increased the glycerin making it even more than their main surfactant. What you may not know is glycerin is a water-soluble filler that has no cleaning properties outside of being a "humectant"(a way to help keep skin hydrated) and keep the mixture thick. It is also much cheaper to buy as an ingredient thus "diluting" down the efficacy of the original formula at the balance of the "maximum hydration". What is the point of having oily moist skin? That is what I get from this and am sad after spending a long-time years ago looking for a compatible face soap that I know how to look for a new soap since this new formula stinks. Soap manufacturers have been adding in lotions and humectants for years at the cost of losing the main function of soap, which is cleaning the skin of oils and foreign materials. Stop diluting the soap!

I ordered 5 of these bottles in September and they all have this new design malfunction.
